description:
Get the details about the acceptance records for a specific agreement.

TIP: Lists acceptances for a terms of use agreement. Each acceptance has userId, userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, state (accepted, declined), recordedDateTime, and expirationDateTime. Useful for compliance reporting on who has accepted terms.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-terms-of-use-acceptances
